items.evidence: The matsa root occurs 7 times across oshb:Eccl.7.26-Eccl.7.29: 1 participle (motse, 7:26) plus 6 more in 7:27-7:29 (5 perfect matsati + 1 infinitive limtso), matching the row's own 'six more times / six tokens over three verses' claim exactly on independent re-derivation.
